text:
Aria: Quick heads-up from the SI delivery call 
Partner deployment in staging is blocked — image pulls failing after our CA roll. Need a fast arch check and a safe fallback so the implementation window isn't lost.

Ben: Can you paste the pull error?

Aria: `docker pull registry.vendorcorp.internal/catalyst:stg` -> `denied: failed to verify signature: unknown authority`

Marta: That smells like the verifier service didn't receive the new CA bundle. Which verifier instance?

ops-bot: verifier-prod-2 reported config version mismatch at 02:12 UTC.

Ben: If reload won't finish in <10m we should allow pull from our mirror cache `mirror.vendors.redwood:5000/catalyst` while we fix verifier. That requires a short egress exception. @sec can we get a 20m rule?

sec: Emergency egress rule approved to 10.11.22.5:5000 for 20 minutes. Audit ticket SEC-781 created.

Marta: Restarted verifier deployment; instance picked up new bundle, health is green.

ops-bot: image-verify job retried -> success.

Aria: Pods are pulling and transitioning to Running. I'll tell the partner we recovered and note the temporary mirror fallback.

Ben: Follow-ups: 1) Add verifier health & CA-propagation to SI preflight checklist, 2) Add mirror-fallback steps to partner runbook, 3) Include verifier instance bake checks in infra rollouts. I'll open INF task.

Aria: Thanks all — marking this resolved and capturing action items in SEC-781 and INF-914. :white_check_mark:
